item.title: Easter Egg Hunt
item.description: The Easter Bunny has lost 100 of her chocolate eggs! This is no yoke! She’ll not be a happy bunny… We need your help! An eggciting Easter Egg hunt for all the family! item.title: Carwyn speaks to Tom about the Celtic Challenge
item.description: Carwyn speaks to Tom about his experience taking part in the Celtic Challenge, the world’s longest true rowing race where teams race from Arklow in County Wicklow, Ireland to Aberystwyth on the Welsh coast, a distance of about 90 nautical miles.

item.title: Pupils from Ysgol Penglais School Music Department visit Radio Bronglais
item.description: Three pupils from the Music Department at Ysgol Penglais School visited Sam & Tom on the Brunch Show to perform some live pieces to tell us about the performances they have been involved in and coming up soon. They also gave Sam & Tom an on-air lesson on playing the ukulele!
